description: Backend TTS infrastructure: service class, config settings, API routes, and caching. Provides text-to-speech MP3 generation using gTTS with hash-based file caching and two endpoints: generic /tts/speak and convenience /tts/recommendation/{id} that reads outfit explanations from the database.
steps: 1. Add gTTS>=2.5 to e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend\requirements.txt (French TTS library, no API key needed)

2. Add TTS config settings to e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend\app\core\config.py following the existing pattern: tts_enabled: bool = True, tts_provider: str = 'gtts', tts_language: str = 'fr', tts_cache_dir: str = './tts_cache' (with comment explaining hash-based caching strategy)

3. Create e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend\app\services\tts_service.py following the StorageService pattern from storage.py: class TTSService with is_configured() returning settings.tts_enabled, speak(text: str) -> bytes method that generates MP3 via gTTS, _hash_text(text) helper using hashlib.sha256 for cache keys, file caching in settings.tts_cache_dir with .mp3 extension, cache hit returns cached bytes, cache miss generates and saves before returning

4. Create e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend\app\api\routes\tts.py with router = APIRouter(prefix='/tts', tags=['tts']). Add POST /speak endpoint accepting text (1-2000 chars) returning StreamingResponse with audio/mpeg content-type, GET /recommendation/{outfit_id} endpoint that fetches Outfit record (with owner_id check per recommendations.py pattern), reads outfit.explanation field, passes to TTSService.speak(), returns StreamingResponse or 404 if outfit not found or 503 if TTS not configured

5. Register the tts router in e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend\app\api\routes\__init__.py: import tts module and add api_router.include_router(tts.router) following the existing pattern after rlhf.router

6. Create the TTS cache directory in e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend\app\main.py at startup following the local_storage_dir pattern: if settings.tts_enabled and settings.tts_cache_dir, create Path(settings.tts_cache_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

7. Create e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend\tests\test_tts_service.py with pytest tests: test_tts_service_is_configured_when_enabled (monkeypatch settings.tts_enabled=True), test_tts_service_disabled_when_flag_off, test_speak_generates_mp3_bytes (mock gTTS), test_speak_uses_cache_on_second_call (tmpdir fixture for cache_dir, assert file exists, assert second call doesn't regenerate), test_hash_consistency (same text = same hash)
acceptance_criteria: gTTS appears in requirements.txt with version pin >=2.5
Config.py has 4 new TTS settings with proper types and defaults
TTSService class exists with is_configured() and speak() methods, follows storage.py coding style
Two TTS routes registered: POST /api/v1/tts/speak and GET /api/v1/tts/recommendation/{id}
tts router imported and registered in __init__.py
TTS cache directory created at app startup when enabled
pytest tests in test_tts_service.py all pass, covering service logic and caching
verification: Run: cd e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend && pytest tests/test_tts_service.py -v (all tests pass)
Run: cd e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend && pytest tests -q (all existing tests still pass)
Start backend: cd e:\Téléchargements\Dress-Me-main\backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
Check: http://localhost:8000/docs shows /api/v1/tts/speak and /api/v1/tts/recommendation/{outfit_id} in the Swagger UI under 'tts' tag
Manual test via Swagger UI: POST /api/v1/tts/speak with body {"text": "Bonjour, ceci est un test"} returns audio/mpeg response, second identical call is instant (cache hit)
